# Psalm 21 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. A psalm of David.

**2** How the king rejoices in Your strength, LORD! He shouts with joy because You give him victory!

**3** You have granted him his heart's desire and have not withheld his request. Pause and reflect.

**4** You welcomed him with rich blessings and placed a crown of finest gold on his head.

**5** He asked You to preserve his life, and You granted his request — days that never end, forever and ever.

**6** Your victory brings him great honor, and You have clothed him with splendor and majesty.

**7** You have endowed him with eternal blessings and given him the joy of Your presence.

**8** For the king trusts in the LORD. The unfailing love of the Most High will keep him from stumbling.

**9** You will capture all your enemies. Your strong right hand will seize all who hate you.

**10** You will throw them in a fiery furnace when you appear. The LORD will consume them in His anger; fire will devour them.

**11** You will wipe their children from the face of the earth; their descendants will never survive.

**12** Although they plot against you, their evil schemes will never succeed.

**13** They will turn and run when they see your arrows aimed at them.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **21:1-7**: This is the companion to Psalm 20. Psalm 20 is the pre-battle prayer; Psalm 21 is the post-victory celebration. Together they frame the battle.

— PNEUMA
